text: Grandson is 6, he's roasting with the fever but his hands and feet are freezing and he's after shivering under the blanket the past while, I can't get him warm. He hasn't done a wee since this morning, that's over 12 hours now, I've been asking him. He's wide awake mind you, sat watching the telly and chatting away to me. Neck's grand, he can look down at his toes no bother. Tell me straight, do I bring him in or not
